name: after-the-poem
description: An evidence-led observatory for worlds continued from a poem.

scripts.doctor:deepseek: uv run python scripts/evaluate.py doctor-profile examples/evaluation-profile-deepseek.json
scripts.evaluation:deepseek: uv run python scripts/evaluate.py run-profile examples/evaluation-profile-deepseek.json
scripts.doctor:deepseek-dream: uv run python scripts/evaluate.py doctor-dream-profile examples/dream-profile-deepseek.json
scripts.evaluation:deepseek-dream: uv run python scripts/evaluate.py run-dream-profile examples/dream-profile-deepseek.json
scripts.build:pages: uv run python scripts/atlas.py build --target pages
scripts.serve:pages: uv run python scripts/atlas.py serve --target pages --port 4318
scripts.test: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run check && npm run build && npm run evaluate -- validate-contract tests/fixtures/evaluation/attribution && npm run test:ui && npm run test:page && npm run test:release
scripts.test:ui: uv run python scripts/atlas.py build --view full && uv run python tests/test_ci_build_restore.py -- node tests/ui-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:page: uv run python scripts/atlas.py build && uv run node tests/page-smoke.mjs
scripts.dev:full: uv run python scripts/atlas.py serve --view full --previews
scripts.test:release: uv run python scripts/atlas.py build --target pages && uv run python tests/test_ci_build_restore.py -- node tests/release-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:engines: uv run python scripts/atlas.py build --target pages && uv run python tests/test_ci_build_restore.py -- sh -c "PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER=webkit node tests/release-smoke.mjs && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER=firefox node tests/release-smoke.mjs"
